## About
Inver Grove Ford is your local Ford dealership on S Robert Trail, serving drivers in Inver Grove Heights, Bloomington, Woodbury and across the Twin Cities. We're part of Saxon Auto Group, locally owned and operated.
Our sales and service staff are here to help you through the whole car-buying process, from the first test drive to the paperwork. Our Saxon Clear Price means the value you see is the value you get.
When it's time for an oil change, tires or brakes, our service center works on all makes and models. We can also pick your car up at home or work, or bring a technician to your driveway. Hablamos Español.

## Services
- New Ford Vehicles: Trucks, SUVs, EVs and hybrids, including popular picks like the Bronco and Explorer.
- Certified Pre-Owned Inventory: Certified pre-owned Fords, plus used vehicles of all kinds.
- Fleet Sales and Service: Work trucks and Transit vans for individuals, startups and large companies, with a dedicated fleet service center.
- Oil Changes: Routine maintenance for your car, truck or SUV. Ask about The Works Package.
- Tire Service: Tires for all makes and models, installed by our service team.
- Car Detailing: Get your vehicle cleaned up while it's with us.
- Ford Pickup & Delivery: We collect your car at your home or office, complete the service and return it to your door at no charge.
- Ford Mobile Service: Rather stay put? We bring the technician to your driveway for routine jobs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on vehicles that aren't Fords?
A: Yes. Our service center works on all makes and models, and our parts center carries what you need for a Ford, Lincoln or another major brand.

Q: When is the showroom open?
A: Sales hours are Monday - Thursday 8:30am-8pm and Friday - Saturday 8:30am-6pm. We're closed Sunday.

Q: What if the vehicle I want isn't on your lot?
A: Vehicles shown at other locations can be brought to our dealership within a reasonable date from your request, not to exceed one week.
